rationale: Price is sitting at 93.7% of today's range near the session high after a large gap-up move, with the last five 1-minute candles showing declining volume and a stall just below the $24.29 high — momentum is fading rather than accelerating. The broader market is under pressure (SPY -1.24%, VIXY +3.90%), which argues against chasing a long at extended levels, while the stock is already far above VWAP ($23.58) and the 9-EMA ($23.83), making a short entry risky without a clear breakdown trigger. With no clean setup in either direction and price consolidating in a narrow band near the high, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
